name: neumanos
description: Privacy-first, local-only personal OS — calendar, notes, kanban, spreadsheets, AI terminal, and 30+ widgets. All data stays on your device. React 19 + TypeScript + IndexedDB.

paragraphs: A privacy-first, local-only platform for organizing your life and work without surrendering your data.
Live Site | Documentation | Report Bug | Request Feature

NeumanOS is an all-in-one productivity platform that lives entirely on your device. Notes, tasks, time tracking, calendar, documents, diagrams, forms, bookmarks, and an AI terminal, all in one app, with no account required and no data leaving your machine unless you connect an AI provider or a live-data widget.

Month, week, day, and agenda views with drag-and-drop rescheduling. Recurring events, browser reminders, conflict detection, and two-way ICS import/export for compatibility with Google Calendar and Apple Calendar. Task…
